messages: A glittering waterfall of metal covers the mountain, something is trying to be said, but I can't hear it over the metal crashing.
The world is covered in a layer of ones and zeroes... wait this is just like that movie, you dream about that one actor you like...
You imagine a digital overlay, giving numbers and statistics. You pick up a spinning gold coin and turn to shoot a demon, high score!
You dream the flesh is melting off your bones... but that's okay, you dance a little jig and your dream changes to be about skeletons dancing.
Typing on a computer, it feels like an eternity, cubicles stretch off into the dark, somethings bothering you... the cubicles vanish. Much better.
You restlessly flit from dream to dream, it's all so confusing and unorganised, you can't sleep like this! ZZZ...
A monster looms over you. Delete. You're running low on ammo, Ctrl C, Ctrl V. You grow hungry and tired, Set Needs to Max.
You hammer your body, both the tool and the creation, you lift your arm and examine it. Perfect.
You hammer your body, both the tool and the creation, you lift your leg and examine it. Perfect.
You hammer your body, both the tool and the creation, you lift your torso and examine it. Excellent.
A nightmare. Rust. Decay. A surge of lightning. You can't even scream.
